name: go-web-starter
description: Generate a full-stack website with a Go REST API, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, PostgreSQL, and account-owned records.

interface.longDescription: Build a website from a brief. Start with a public landing page, email and password accounts, and a private workspace where each user can create, view, edit, and delete their own records. Customize the site name, resource, fields, and copy. The generated project includes a Go REST API, a React and TypeScript frontend styled with Tailwind CSS, PostgreSQL migrations, a Docker Compose setup, and tests.
defaultPrompt: Create a project tracker called Fieldbook with a landing page, accounts, and a private project dashboard.
Build a client portal with sign-up and a dashboard for creating, viewing, editing, and deleting clients.

prompts: Build a personal reading list called Shelf with email sign-in and private book records.
Create a client workspace called Studio Desk. Include an editable company name and contact email on each client.

publication.release_notes: Initial release with customizable website generation, account sessions, owner-scoped REST CRUD, and Docker Compose.
